title: 2017 Bowman Draft Chrome 1st Bowman Refractor Riley Adams #BDC-13 Blue Jays
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2017 Bowman Draft Chrome 1st Bowman Refractor card features Riley Adams, a rookie player for the Toronto Blue Jays in Major League Baseball. The card is a single-insert and is an original from the manufacturer, Topps. It has a card number of BDC-13 and is part of the 2017 season.

The card is a parallel/variety with a chrome refractor and is an authentic product from the United States. It is a great addition to any baseball trading card collection and is perfect for fans of the Toronto Blue Jays. Get your hands on this unique card and add it to your collection today!
